collection.name: Style atlas: 86 animated explainer looks
collection.publisher_basis: Preview media is hosted on cdn.futurepedia.io and the collection is associated with Futurepedia's explainer tutorial. Publisher identity and authorship were not otherwise verified.
collection.licence: Not verified. The published prompts and code are not licensed for bundling here and are not included.

availability.metadata: Bundled: ids, names, family labels, Kit to Clip descriptor tags, preview links and source hashes.
availability.source: Not bundled. Using a style's original prompt needs your own local copy, passed explicitly with "catalogue.py load <id> --source-root <folder>"; its sha256 must match. Loading a private copy grants no public or redistribution rights.
availability.runtime_validation: No runtime validation: no entry has been rendered, tested or approved inside Kit to Clip.

fields.id: The publisher's style identifier. Kit to Clip refers to it as library:<id>.
fields.name: The publisher's display name (factual identifier).
fields.ground: Overall background tone read from the description: dark, light or unknown when not clear.
fields.look: Short descriptors of the visual look, written for Kit to Clip from the publisher's description.
fields.motion: Short descriptors of how things move, from the same description.
fields.explains: Short descriptors of the explanation devices used in the publisher's demo.
fields.fit: Inferred guidance only: subjects or tones the look may suit, judged by reading. Not tested with audiences, not a guarantee.
fields.comparison_labels: Labels the research recorded for cross-reference to looks with similar names. Not a claim that Kit to Clip's own looks are this source.
fields.preview: Links to the publisher's hosted media, never downloaded or embedded: style_frame_video is the style-frame demo, explainer_clip is the original full explainer.
fields.source: prompt_sha256 is the sha256 of the original prompt text (UTF-8), used to verify a private local copy. code_chars and js_blocks describe the published code size; no code is included.

evidence: Tags were written by reading the publisher's one-paragraph descriptions (look, motion, explanation approach) and names. No source code was run and no preview media was downloaded.
limitations: Every publisher demo explains the same topic (a model learning from labelled examples); fit for other subjects is inferred.
Search is keyword and tag matching. It produces a shortlist for a director to judge, not a ranking of quality.
Descriptor tags are a reading of short descriptions and may miss or misjudge traits; doubtful backgrounds are marked unknown.
Preview links point to third-party hosting and may change or disappear.

Original prompts, code, fonts and media are not included; load accepts the exported source package unchanged as {"info": {"id": ...}, "prompt": ...}, {"info": {"styleId": ...}, "prompt": ...} or {"id": ..., "prompt": ...}; every identifier present must match.
